sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Try clicking on p to restart
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 47, 'col': 17}])

print(f"State: {last_action_result.get('state', 'N/A')}")
print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over', False)}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed', False)}")
print(f"Done: {last_action_result.get('done', False)}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('p', 'G', 'W') and n['pixels'] > 3 and n['pixels'] < 50:
        b = n['boundary']
        center_r = round(sum(p[0] for p in b)/len(b))
        center_c = round(sum(p[1] for p in b)/len(b))
        print(f"{n['color']} (px={n['pixels']}): center=({center_r}, {center_c})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
